display_name: PVI comprehensive health care insurance rules (Quy tắc bảo hiểm chăm sóc sức khỏe toàn diện) for individual customers: eligibility, termination and liability, definitions, personal accident, inpatient, outpatient, dental, maternity and death-from-illness benefits with their waiting periods and amounts, the 35 general exclusions, the claims procedure and dispute resolution

run.method: one agent, one session (resumed once after a usage-limit pause), no sub-agents, from BRIEF.md

language.note: Identifiers and comments are English (@lang en). Vietnamese is quoted only in `-- src:N |` comments generated mechanically from line N of the raw text by tools/vnsrc.py quote, and in short runs elsewhere checked by tools/vnsrc.py check to occur verbatim in it; the one line of the encoder's own Vietnamese (search strings in NOTES.md) carries the [translator] marker.

source.sha256_of: the PDF (subject.json); the text rendering is fcb4bd688ac76d9456286c5826862aee296e179739f2fe06ca93bc62a50ffa80
source.authority: aid: a MIRROR on an insurance agent's website, not PVI's own; no decision number or date in the document; printed pages 24-26 absent

scope: The whole document: Parts I-VI, every clause, definition, list and exclusion item (139 coverage rows: 110 encoded, 27 inert, 1 out-of-scope, 1 reached-and-refused, 0 deferred; NOTES.md section 2). Inputs, not gaps: the schedule of benefits (every sum insured, limit, premium, the programmes) and the annex of injury percentages, neither of which is in the published copy. Out of scope: A.2.3(c), the other benefits that exist only in the schedule. Declined by a named REFUSE: the refund in the other cases of termination that Part I 5.2 leaves to the law in force. The Law on Insurance Business is read as an aid and not encoded; its conflicts are LAW: rows of the fork register.

forks.F1: Part I 1: the worldwide accident benefit is A.1 only.
forks.F2: The programmes are an input; the document does not define them.
forks.F3: Every age by the last birthday, end ages inclusive.
forks.F4: Eligibility ages on the start date; co-payment age on the treatment date; the 180-day period and item 9 on the event date.
forks.F5: Part I 2.2 (and item 34) read at enrolment, not at the claim.
forks.F6: Part I 3 as an amount, not item by item.
forks.F8: The early-termination date is not covered; the remaining period counts it and the end date.
forks.F9: The remaining premium pro rata by days.
forks.F10: A refund limb whose condition fails gives nothing.
forks.F11: The date the event arose is an input (onset).
forks.F12: A one-year term ends the day before the first anniversary.
forks.F13: LAW Art 22(2): refund on cancellation for dishonesty; Rules followed (no refund), flagged.
forks.F14: A.1 and B.4 pay their own sums insured; the annual cap applies to the medical benefits; the five medical limits are the sub-limits; each limit as the schedule allows for the claim.
forks.F15: The partial-permanent-injury definition's 'toàn bộ' read as 'bộ phận'.
forks.F16: Deemed pre-existing diseases whenever they arise; 3 years inclusive; measured from the chain start.
forks.F17: Nằm viện: 24 hours qualifies the inpatient limb only.
forks.F18: Standard room as a price cap on the bed charge.
forks.F19: Waiting periods apply only where the certificate shows them.
forks.F20: Co-payment percentage applied to the lower of cost and sub-limit.
forks.F21: A.1.4 (iv) prevails over Part I 10 for a death within a year; nothing for a death after a year; permanent injury arises with the accident.
forks.F22: An N-day waiting period is over once N days have elapsed (start day counted).
forks.F23: LAW Art 31(2): interest on late payment; Rules followed (no interest), flagged.
forks.F24: Co-payment applies in a public hospital's international department.
forks.F25: The longest applicable waiting period applies.
forks.F26: A.2 pays a hospitalisation or a surgery; pregnancy is claimed under B.3.
forks.F27: Order: % x min(cost, sub-limit), then Part I 3, then the sum insured left.
forks.F29: Item 2's proviso does not save the insured person's own claim.
forks.F30: Item 8's rescue proviso qualifies the danger limb only.
forks.F32: Item 22 limited to the named conditions.
forks.F33: Item 27's cost proviso attaches to the support limb only.
forks.F34: Claim documents: accident report for every accident, vehicle papers when driving, payment documents for cost benefits.
forks.F35: 12 months to claim is operative (Part V 5; LAW Art 30(1)); 6 months (Part V 3) encoded for the finding.
forks.F36: Working days: Monday to Friday less supplied holidays.
forks.F37: The special-disease list's missing comma: two items, 28 rows.
forks.F38: LAW Art 26: at-will unilateral termination; Rules followed, flagged.
forks.F39: Scaling once per insurance year; the 10% emergency dental cap per claim.
forks.F40: Item 20 follow-up limb: strict 'more than 30 days', no discharge no exclusion.
forks.F41: Item 17 applies to the insured person's conditions, not the foetus's.
